name: Multipress — Centralized publishing, controlled local edits for enterprise departmental or regional sites
author: MULTIDOTS Inc

sections.description:
Managing content across a WordPress multisite network means manually publishing the same update dozens of times.

Multipress changes that. It lets you create, update, and sync content from a single central dashboard to any or all of your subsites — automatically — while giving you full control over which sites receive which content.
Whether you run departmental sites, regional hubs, or a franchise network, Multipress keeps every site consistent without the manual overhead.

Key Features

  • Centralized Content Hub: Manage posts, pages, taxonomies, and media for your entire multisite network from one dashboard — no switching between sites.
  • Selective Site Synchronization: Choose exactly which subsites receive each piece of content. Customize distribution by site and content type.
  • Automated & Manual Updates: Set content to sync automatically on publish, or push updates manually for more control over timing.
  • Multi-Content Type Support: Sync posts, pages, categories, tags, and media files across your network in one operation.
  • Subsite Editing Control: Lock synced content on subsites to prevent local edits, keeping your network content consistent and centrally managed.
  • Synced Deletions: When content is removed from the central hub, Multipress automatically removes it from connected subsites — no cleanup required.

Publish once. Reach every site. Stay in control with Multipress.

Why Choose Multipress?

  • One Dashboard, Every Site: Stop logging into each subsite to publish the same update. Multipress brings your entire network’s content under one roof, dramatically reducing publishing time.
  • Publish to the Right Sites Only: Not every update belongs on every site. Multipress lets you select exactly which subsites receive each content push, so regional or departmental content stays targeted.
  • You Control What Gets Edited: Synced content can be locked on subsites so local editors can’t alter centrally managed posts and pages, maintaining brand and message consistency across your network.
  • Handles Every Content Type: Posts, pages, categories, tags, media — Multipress syncs everything your network needs, not just basic post content.
  • Deletions Stay Clean: Remove a post from the hub, and Multipress removes it everywhere it was synced. No orphaned content, no manual cleanup across subsites.

EXPLORE OUR OTHER PLUGINS

  • Multipasskey — Deploy enterprise-level, passwordless security
  • Multigovernance — Multi-user site with role-based permissions for blocks and settings.
  • Multisync — Sync external data to custom fields to turn static sites into dynamic hubs.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the centralized-content-management directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings page in the network admin to configure syncing options and select subsites for content sync.
sections.faq:
What is Multipress and who is it for?

Multipress is a WordPress multisite plugin that lets you manage and sync content from a central site to any number of subsites. It’s built for organizations running departmental, regional, or franchise networks on WordPress multisite.

Do I need technical skills to set it up?

No. Install the plugin, go to CCM Settings in the network admin dashboard, select your content types and subsites, and you’re ready to sync.

Can I choose which subsites each piece of content is displayed on?

Yes. Multipress lets you select specific subsites per content push, so you’re not forced to broadcast everything network-wide.

What content types does Multipress sync?

Posts, pages, categories, tags, and media files.

Can I prevent subsite editors from changing synced content?

Yes. Multipress includes an option to lock synced content on subsites, so only the central hub can make changes.

What happens when I delete content from the central hub?

Multipress automatically deletes the corresponding content from any subsite it was synced to, keeping your network clean.

Can I sync content manually instead of automatically?

Yes. You can choose between automated syncing on publish or manual pushes when you need more control over timing.

Is Multipress compatible with third-party plugins?

Multipress is designed to work with most WordPress plugins. We recommend testing in a staging environment before deploying to production.

How do I get support?

Post your question on the WordPress.org support forum for the plugin and the Multidots team will assist you.
